responsibility: Defines GCC’s configured default include-directory table and related relocation metadata used to seed the preprocessor’s standard header search paths. It owns the compiled-in cpp_include_defaults array, exported configure-time prefix strings, GCC private include directory identifiers, and the cpp_relocated runtime check that detects relocation via GCC_EXEC_PREFIX so clients such as incpath.cc can adjust or suppress standard include handling appropriately.
same_name_distinction: This is the data/implementation side of the cppdefault pair: it instantiates the compiled-in cpp_include_defaults table, exports configured prefix strings, and implements the relocation check in cpp_relocated. Unlike gcc/cppdefault.h, it provides the actual configured include-path data and runtime logic rather than just declaring their shape.
